# Interface: CollectionToken\<TokenSymbol *extends* `symbol`, Item\>

Defined in: [tokens.ts:39](https://github.com/dany-fedorov/di-bag/blob/main/src/tokens.ts#L39)

An immutable typed-token handle pairing a canonical symbol with an invariant
collection item contract.
Create one with `DiBag.token(key).forCollectionOf<Item>()`.

## Extends

- [`CollectionTokenBase`](CollectionTokenBase.md)

## Type Parameters

| Type Parameter | Description |
| ------ | ------ |
| `TokenSymbol` | The unique symbol that is this token's runtime identity. |
| `Item` | The item type accepted by contributions and returned in collection views. |
